[EN] Fighting on an Empty Stomach
[ES] Luchando con el estómago vacío
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Soldiers can't fight without food. We need those rations in the field.
[ES] Los soldados no pueden pelear sin comida. Necesitamos esas raciones en el campo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The Shariar thank you!
[ES] ¡Los Shariar te lo agradecen!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll get these to the fighters."
[ES] "Llevaré esto a los combatientes."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Meet {@LinkCreature:78#3008#Artur} at {@Rgn:78001$$Zulfikar Fortress} and collect the emergency rations.
[ES] Reúnete con {@LinkCreature:78#3008#Artur} en {@Rgn:78001$$Zulfikar Fortress} y recoge las raciones de emergencia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with {@LinkCreature:248#3003#Vikhonul} at {@Rgn:48002$$Khanovar Citadel}.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I won't fail you."
[ES] "No te fallaré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Some food to keep you in the fight!"
[ES] "¡Algo de comida para mantenerte en la pelea!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
